title: KV-Align for Streaming LLMs
description: A predictive model that corrects positionally encoded tokens in KV caches for streaming inference, delivering up to a 50% speed-up over cache recomputation.
imageAlt: Predictive neural network aligning a misaligned KV cache

title: DynamicSwap
description: An extension to Application-Integrated Far Memory that monitors resource behavior and uses multi-threaded optimizations to reduce tail latency by up to 20,000× on real workloads.

title: Inter-Dependent Loop Inversion for LLVM
description: Reordering inter-dependent nested loops to achieve up to a 20.7× speed-up over LLVM’s auto-vectorizer and a 41.2% reduction in dynamic instructions.

title: Elo-Integrated Evaluation for Chess Engines
description: A chess evaluation metric that accounts for player Elo, improving game-outcome prediction accuracy for lower-rated players by up to 20% over Stockfish baselines.

title: C Webserver Library
description: A C library for HTTP/1.x requests, DNS resolution from root name servers, and multi-threaded request handling to improve throughput and response times.

title: Distributed Computing Interface
description: A fault-tolerant worker–manager system for distributed job execution, deployed on AWS EC2 with Route 53 to run large-scale tasks in parallel.
imageAlt: Manager server distributing work to four worker servers

title: Little Computer Compiler
description: A C++ compiler for an educational assembly language, using abstract syntax trees, symbol tables, and dead code elimination. Tested from parsing through binary generation.

title: Chess Visual Helper
description: A Chrome extension that helps visually impaired players on chess.com by capturing audio input and mapping moves to a digital board, with automated Cypress tests.
imageAlt: Green pawn surrounded by chess pieces

title: Banking Web Application
description: A React front end and Python REST API for core banking workflows, with JWT authentication and a distributed MongoDB data layer.

title: Stock Trading Application
description: An Electron desktop app for stock data and statistical risk analysis, backed by a Flask REST API and protected with TOTP multi-factor authentication.
